messages:
marta: Heads-up: planning a blue/green for router pool A -> B tonight 23:00 UTC. Window 60m. Goal is a service swap + tiny DB migration. Everyone please read runbook excerpt and call veto now. TL;DR: stagger 10% -> 40% -> 50% over 10m/20m/30m, with auto-rollback thresholds p95 +200ms or errors >0.5%. Beta tenants will stay pinned to pool-A for 2h.
raul: +1 from infra. I'll pre-warm pool-B at 22:30 and watch node readiness.
linh: Can someone post the exact lb/cli commands we'll run? I'll be on-call and want to confirm syntax.
alex: Suggested deploy CLI: `/deploy router --target=pool-B --strategy=gradual --phases=10,40,50 --durations=600,1200,1800 --probe=p95:200ms,errors:0.5 --pin=router:v2.4.1`
priya: small nit: numbers vs timings — earlier threads had different splits. Let's standardize: 10%/40%/50% with 10m/20m/30m respectively. Also confirm if session-affinity is preserved.
marta: Good call. Use 10/40/50 with 10m/20m/30m. Beta stays on pool-A. We'll enable sticky cookie for enterprise tenants. I'll update release notes after this thread.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: running preflight for router:v2.4.1 -> pool-B. Health checks: OK. KV cache warmup: 83% (eta 22:46 UTC).
raul: preflight looks good. I'll run a dry-run of the lb change at 22:40 to validate automation.
linh: LB CLI we keep in runbook: ```rbctl traffic shift --from pool-A --to pool-B --weights 10,40,50 --durations 600,1200,1800 --rollback-metrics "latency_p95>200ms||errors>0.5"``` saving to runbook now.
marta: Adding a manual gate: if N+1 alerts for router errors trigger in first 5m of any phase, pause and call #oncall. priya is primary, raul backup. Agree?
alex: Agree. Also attaching release notes link: https://internal/releasenotes/1745 (will include pinned version and known regressions).
priya: Quick check re: session affinity — router supports cookie-based affinity; set header `X-Session-Persist: cookie` on pool-B before shift.
raul: I'll apply the header and confirm. Also pre-warm adjusted pool size +2 for headroom.
linh: Documenting fallback command in runbook: ```rbctl traffic shift --force-roll-back --to pool-A``` keep that handy on-call.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary started: phase 1 at 23:00:10 -> 10%. Metrics stream: https://metrics/streams/shift/1759002468
priya: Watching metrics live. p95 +23ms, errors 0.02% — looks healthy. :thumbsup:
marta: Waiting for 10m gate then proceed to 40%. If we see any spike > thresholds we stop.
deploy-bot: phase 2 initiated 23:10:12 -> 40%. No alerts so far.
alex: Confirming release-notes-bot pinned router:v2.4.1 for this rollout.
release-notes-bot: release-notes-bot: Added entry: "router v2.4.1 — blue/green A->B, staged traffic 10/40/50, affinity cookie enabled for enterprise, rollback thresholds set."
marta: After 100% and 30m stable, plan to evict pool-A and mark pool-B as primary. We'll drain old nodes gracefully per drain runbook.
raul: Rollback playbook reminder: 1) pause shift 2) force-roll-back to pool-A 3) revert pin if needed 4) open incident `#inc-rolling-routers` and notify SRE. Keep command handy.
linh: Also note: if session-affinity customers see stickiness issues, apply sticky-cookie TTL 24h and route header-based fallback.
priya: Oncall watching dashboards, will escalate if anomalies.
marta: All green here. Kicking at 23:00 unless someone vetoes within 15m.
raul: :thumbsup:
priya: :thumbsup:
alex: :shipit:
